products.notes: JL Audio owner's manual (Garmin download server). 0.75 in (19 mm) silk dome, NOTE 8 ohm nominal. Continuous power handling 60 W (with C2 crossover); recommended amp 15-100 W RMS. Efficiency also given as 91.5 dB @ 1W/0.5m. No T/S published. Flush fixture mounting depth 9.1 mm.

JL Audio owner's manual (Garmin download server). 1 in (25 mm) alloy-dome tweeter. Continuous power 100 W; recommended amp 50-150 W RMS. Usable range: 3-30 kHz (48 dB/oct), 4-30 kHz (24 dB/oct), 5-30 kHz (12 dB/oct). Supplied 15 uF protection capacitor is not a substitute for a high-pass filter. JL C7 manuals' suggested 3-way starting points: woofer LP 400 Hz LR24; midrange HP 480 Hz / LP 3500 Hz LR24; tweeter HP 4500 Hz LR24 (-1 dB). 2-way: woofer LP 2700 Hz, tweeter HP 4000 Hz LR24. Passive crossovers not recommended (active/DSP only).
